## Current Issues

### Many Items With Low Difficulty

We urgently need a greater variety of mid and higher difficulty items. Start batch creation of difficult items in Gemini and see if we can expedite reviewing from SMEs.

### Items With Very Low Exposure

We have many items with very low exposure, this makes estimating item parameters very difficult.

**ACTION:** Look into platform settings on whether we can set the test to present similar difficulty items with equal frequencies. Possible buckets or bins of items with similar difficulties. This is challenging with current iteration as many items are having very similar difficulties.

### Potential AI involvement in Test Completion

There are indications that candidates could be using AI to complete the test, some potential actions are identified below.

-   **Delivery and Interface Constraints:** Employing a secure browser that tracks tab switching, detects virtual machine environments, and monitors mouse movements outside the test window can help flag when a candidate attempts to move the question to an external AI tool. (Near Future Implementation)

-   **Impose Time Limits:** Although the Civil Service Numerical Test (CSNT) is traditionally untimed to measure pure cognitive power, introducing tight time limits is a primary countermeasure against AI. If the time limit is strict enough, the workflow of transferring the question to an AI, prompting it, and interpreting the response becomes impossible to execute before time expires. (Near Future Implementation)

-   **Fragment the Item Presentation:** AI tools excel when fed a complete, self-contained prompt. You can disrupt this by ensuring the full question is never exposed on the screen at the same time. For instance, requiring the candidate to pull context from an interactive data dashboard or disparate tables rather than a single paragraph makes the data much harder to efficiently feed to an LLM. (Far Future Implementation)

-   **Transition to Gamified Assessments:** The most robust defense against AI is converting the numerical reasoning construct into a gamified format. By requiring continuous interaction with dynamic, changing content—such as performing rapid arithmetic on moving elements in real-time—you eliminate the static text that AI relies on, effectively neutralizing cheating through test design rather than surveillance. (Far Future Implementation)

-   **Live Verification:** Incorporate a multi-method battery where the online assessment is followed by a brief live interview. Asking the candidate to verbally explain the cognitive steps they took to arrive at the 23.625% solution for NR-H050 usually exposes applicants who relied on an LLM, as they often fail to articulate the underlying logic. (Could be proposed to hiring departments)
